## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test` pass locally
- [ ] Touches execution / positions / gates? Paper and Live paths both covered (CLAUDE.md)
- [ ] No keys, tokens, balances or trade data in code, logs or screenshots
- [ ] New logged fields are in the trade log, CSV export and `DATA_DICTIONARY.md`
- [ ] Desktop change? Tried with `pnpm desktop:dev`
